audit.whatIsWrong: Ornn’s E was called "Pillar of Flame", which is not one of his abilities.
audit.why: His E is Searing Charge (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) and it only knocks up when he collides with terrain — including the magma pillar left by Volcanic Rupture (Q). Watching for "Pillar of Flame" means watching for nothing; watching for the pillar-then-charge sequence is the actual tell.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name killed in wants.you[1], spikes[0], early and mid; the Q-pillar into E-charge combo is now described.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 flip named his ult but gave no cooldown and missed the recast.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s, and Riot's text says Ornn can recast to charge into the elemental, redirecting it so that it KNOCKS UP everything it runs over and re-applies Brittle. The second hit is the one that cancels an Aatrox commit, and the page only described the first.
audit.corrected: late now gives the 140s and states the recast knockup; mid states the Brittle re-application.

audit.whatIsWrong: Brittle was mentioned as a word without ever saying what applies it.
audit.why: Riot's text: enemies hit by the FINAL gout of Bellows Breath become Brittle, and Call of the Forge God re-applies it. Bellows Breath is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, so the Brittle window has a countable cooldown you can trade around.
audit.corrected: early, spikes[0], mid and wants.foe[1] now tie Brittle to Bellows Breath and give its 12s.

edits.before: Punish him between Bellows Breath and Pillar (E) cooldowns
edits.after: Punish him between Bellows Breath and Searing Charge (E)

edits.before: Your window: land Q3 sweetspot and drain in extended trades before he has plates and tank items. Punish him hard between his W (Bellows Breath) and E cooldowns.
edits.after: Your window: land Q3 sweetspot and drain in extended trades before he has plates and tank items. Punish him hard between Bellows Breath (W, 12s) and Searing Charge (E, 14s).

edits.before: Set up Brittle with E-Pillar and detonate the knockup
edits.after: Set up Brittle with W, then knock you up off a pillar

edits.before: You're ahead from Level 1-2 — Ornn is passive and short-ranged early, and while his W (Bellows Breath) grants damage reduction and an unstoppable window that soaks part of your opening, your base kit still out-pressures a farm-focused tank. Don't over-commit into his Pillar of Flame (E) poke and Brittle setup, but do lean on him for CS. Get your Level 3 spike online and you widen the lead. He can't kill you here and you out-trade his low early damage.
edits.after: You're ahead from level 1-2 — Ornn is passive and short-ranged early, and while Bellows Breath (W, 12s) soaks part of your opening and leaves you Brittle, your base kit still out-pressures a farm-focused tank. Don't over-commit into Volcanic Rupture (Q): the fissure slows, then a magma pillar forms, and Searing Charge (E) into that pillar is what knocks you up. Get your level 3 spike online and widen the lead.

edits.before: Level 3 through 5 is your window: land Q3 sweetspots and drain while Ornn is still squishy relative to his late self, punishing him every time Bellows Breath and Pillar are down. Press that lead — but know it's finite. At 6, Call of the Forge God plus his tank spike lets him disengage your combo, tank the drain, and Brittle-knockup you out of the fight, flipping the lane his way. Bank your early advantage before the flip and stop forcing trades once his items come online.
edits.after: Level 3 through 5 is your window: land Q3 sweetspots and drain while Ornn is still squishy relative to his late self, punishing him whenever Bellows Breath (12s) and Searing Charge (14s) are down. Press that lead — but know it's finite. At 6, Call of the Forge God plus his tank spike lets him disengage, tank the drain, and re-apply Brittle for a knockup, flipping the lane his way. Bank your early advantage before the flip and stop forcing trades once his self-forged items come online.

edits.before: Ornn is a premier scaler and this is his half of the matchup. His self-upgraded masterwork items, armour stacking, and teamfight ult make him a wall your drain simply can't chew through in a solo fight, and Brittle turns his CC into a burst-and-knockup that cancels World Ender's value. Don't dive him in the sidelane; group with your team and let your carries do the work while you peel. He wins first-item, second-item, and the teamfight — play for your early lead if you got one, or farm even and scale to your own comp.
edits.after: Ornn is a premier scaler and this is his half of the matchup. His self-forged masterwork items, Living Forge bonus resists and teamfight ult make him a wall your drain can't chew through solo, and Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) recasts into a second knockup that cancels your commit outright. Don't dive him in the sidelane; group with your team and let your carries do the work while you peel. He wins first-item, second-item, and the teamfight — play for your early lead if you got one, or farm even and scale to your own comp.

notes: NOT VERIFIED and therefore left in place untouched: the existing claim that Bellows Breath grants "damage reduction and an unstoppable window". Riot's Data Dragon text for Bellows Breath states only the advance, the fire, and Brittle — it says nothing about damage reduction or unstoppable, and that is exactly the class of fact the kit files are documented not to carry. Not asserted, not removed. Packet flagged "Bellows Breath's" as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE, correct Riot name. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only); no grounding claim was made in this slice.
